# M3VO

> M3VO is a shared WhatsApp inbox and customer communication platform. It brings a team's WhatsApp conversations, enquiries, and follow-ups into one workspace — with no-code automation and an AI copilot included from the entry tier, priced per seat rather than per contact. Meta and BSP messaging fees are itemized at cost on every invoice, never marked up.

Company: Mevo Tech, a project by Curative Holdings.
Contact: hello@m3vo.com
Website: https://m3vo.com/

## Product

M3VO lets multiple team members manage customer conversations from one workspace:

- Receive and reply to WhatsApp messages
- Assign conversations to specific team members
- Add internal notes for team collaboration
- Organise conversations by status (open, pending, resolved)
- Track customer enquiries and follow-ups
- Create automated messaging workflows (no-code, included from Starter)
- Use AI assistance to draft replies, summarise conversations, and qualify leads
- Maintain visibility across customer-facing teams
- Manage multiple WhatsApp numbers from one platform
- Connect customer conversations with existing business systems
- Lightweight CRM / pipeline view alongside the shared inbox
- Connects exclusively through an official WhatsApp Business Solution Provider (BSP) — not an unofficial library

## Who it's for

M3VO is built for businesses that have outgrown the standard WhatsApp Business app, including: clinics and healthcare businesses, dental and aesthetic clinics, retail and e-commerce businesses, professional service providers, education and training providers, and multi-location businesses.

## Pricing (USD/month, per seat — illustrative, confirm current rates at m3vo.com/#pricing)

- Starter: $19/mo — 1–2 seats, shared inbox, contact profiles, basic automation
- Growth: $49/mo — up to 5 seats, no-code automation builder, AI copilot, lightweight CRM
- Scale: $99/mo — generous seat cap, multi-channel (WhatsApp + Instagram + web), priority support

Plans exclude Meta/BSP per-message fees, which are passed through at cost and itemized separately — never marked up. Pricing is based on team size, not the size of a business's contact list.

## Positioning vs. the category

M3VO competes with respond.io, Wati, SleekFlow, Kommo, Trengo, Interakt, AiSensy, and Gallabox. The differentiation: automation and AI are included at the entry tier instead of gated behind a $79–$159/mo plan, and pricing is per seat instead of per contact / monthly-active-contact.

## Frequently asked

- What is M3VO? — A shared WhatsApp inbox and customer communication platform for teams.
- Is M3VO official? — Yes, connects via an official WhatsApp Business Solution Provider, not an unofficial library.
- Is M3VO a CRM? — It includes CRM-style functionality (pipeline, contact profiles, history) alongside the inbox.
- Is M3VO only for large companies? — No, built for growing SMBs as well as larger teams; pricing is per seat.
